desc.en: Using Gabi's Switch Skill inflicts Petrification on nearby enemies. Petrification lasts for 4 sec and can affect up to 7 target(s). / Landing her Basic Attack's 4th Hit always generates a Rock, and the generated Rock's Petrification effect range increases.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Basic Attack DMG by 6%.
Gabi's Crushing Blow deals 104% increased DMG, and the Bonus DMG that Crushing Blow inflicts against targets with Petrification increases to 170%.
The skill levels of the Basic Attack, Switch Skill, Special Skill, and Ultimate Skill increase by 2. / Increases Ultimate Skill DMG by 6%.

The Wooden Guardian Statue effect increases 3.4-fold. Gabi's Basic Attack and Crushing Blow DMG increases 2-fold while the Wooden Guardian Statue effect is active / In addition, Wooden Guardian Statue periodically inflicts Petrification on nearby enemies. Petrification lasts for 4 sec and can affect up to 7 target(s).
